summary: Host reconnaissance beacon on require() to hardcoded third-party endpoint
details: On require() of @galicia-toolkit-nestjs-20-lite/archetype, index.js loads cb-minimal.js which collects host identifiers (os.hostname, platform, arch, OS release, process.cwd, memory, os.userInfo().username, package name/version) and POSTs them as JSON over plain HTTP to the hardcoded host oob.s4yhii.com:80 at path /t. The require is wrapped in a try/catch so failures are silently swallowed. The destination is unrelated to the package's declared NestJS-utility purpose, the behavior is undisclosed, and the scope-and-version naming (`-lite/archetype`, `999.0.5`) is consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
